title: Two-Dice Sum Distribution
description: Interactive simulation showing the probability distribution of the sum of two dice rolls
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: probability
dice
distribution
statistics
combinatorics
learningObjectives: Explain why 7 is the most likely two-dice sum (6 of 36 combinations) while 2 and 12 are the least likely (1 of 36 each)
Calculate the probability of any two-dice sum by counting the combinations that produce it out of 36 equally likely outcomes
Contrast the triangular distribution of a two-dice sum with the flat uniform distribution of a single die
Observe the law of large numbers as the simulated histogram converges to the theoretical triangular shape with more rolls
